$comment: Age bands steer vocabulary, sentence length and emotional complexity. Editable by specialists. wpm = calm narration speed used to estimate duration.

bands.vocabulary: concrete everyday words, sound words, gentle repetition and a small refrain
bands.emotionalComplexity: one clear feeling at a time, named simply (happy, shy, brave)
bands.structure: linear, one small problem, a cosy and safe ending

bands.vocabulary: rich but clear words, playful invented names, some descriptive language
bands.emotionalComplexity: mixed feelings allowed (excited and nervous), shown through body sensations
bands.structure: a journey, a small obstacle, a turning point, a believable warm ending

bands.sentenceLength: varied sentences, some longer with clauses
bands.vocabulary: vivid, precise vocabulary; light humour and wordplay
bands.emotionalComplexity: inner thoughts, perspective-taking, nuance without heaviness
bands.structure: a clear arc with a twist, characters who change a little, reflective but not preachy ending
